data.one_liner: Generate QR code images with logos easily using image processing and QR code libraries.
data.what_it_does: Generates QR code images with embedded logos by leveraging existing image processing and QR code libraries. It provides a simple programmatic API to create customizable QR code images.
use_when: You need to generate QR code images programmatically in Dart
You want to embed logos inside your generated QR codes
avoid_when: You need a Flutter-specific widget for rendering QR codes directly inside the widget tree (this generates image objects)
You require advanced camera-based QR code scanning
strengths: Simplifies QR code generation with custom logos
Uses popular underlying image and QR libraries
weaknesses: Minimal feature set for initial version
